text: If you ignore me again, I may have no choice but to do the same when you need me.
God says don't skip. Pay very close attention to what comes next.
When you receive this blessing, keep your mouth shut. This is not for everybody. If this video
reached you today, it was 100% meant for you. I have tried in many different ways to deliver
this message. Here, I finally found a way to reach you. This is the last message the universe
will ever send you. The worst is finally over. The universe has already decided. Powerful good
news is already moving toward you. Pay very close attention to what I am about to say right now.
But don't stop watching or the news will turn against you. A powerful blessing is coming
your way with force. This is the universe's final message, so take it seriously.
Now like this video. That will be your first seal. Save this post. That will be your second seal.
Send it to yourself. That will be your third seal. Write except in the comments so I can see
you completed every seal. If you did everything correctly, your blessing begins moving toward
you within the next 33 minutes. One last thing. Click on my profile picture and check my stories
before they disappear. Because the second part of this sign is waiting for you there.
